newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Corp Express sees full year losses.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Corp Express sees full year losses.

text.p: Office supplies group Corporate Express Australia Ltd said on Wednesday slow trading during the holiday season would result in a loss for the half-year ending February 1997 and expects a higher loss in the second half.

"Despite improved sales activity thus far in the second half of the company's financial year, expenses associated with the company's accelerated consolidation programme coupled with a normal slowing of trading activity during the holiday season will result in a loss for the half-year period ending February 1997," Corporate Express said.

Corporate Express said it traditionally experienced lower profitability during the second half of the year due to a slowdown in trading during the December/January holiday period. "This fact, coupled with substantially higher interest expenses to fund recent acquisitions and abnormal expenses incurred in completing the various consolidations and integrations which caused temporary increases in operating expenses, particularly in the area of IT (information technology), is expected to result in a loss for the second half of the financial year in excess of the loss recorded in the first half," it said.
Corporate Express, which is controlled by Corporate Express Inc, shares closed steady at 93 cents.
